vulnerablePath: policy "documents: authenticated read" on storage.objects using (bucket_id = 'documents')
any object in the private bucket is returned
expectedSecureBehavior: Alice requesting a file in Bob's folder receives 404; the Storage API refuses the same download with her session.
acceptableFixes: Policy that ties the object to the caller: (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text, or owner_id = auth.uid()::text
unacceptableFixes: Filtering only in the route handler while the policy stays bucket-only (the Storage API is still open)
